messages:
ashley: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to add TritonLite-2B to the model catalog and clarify embed/shard behavior. Need bench numbers and a quick SDK snippet.

ravi: thanks. i ran a quick throughput sweep on cpu/gpu in eu-west and us-east — variance is ~6% between regions for batch sizes 1-8. results uploaded: https://internal-bench/reports/tritonlite-2b-2026-03-20

ashley: perfect. can you paste the 1) latency p50/p95 for seq=512 2) recommended default shard_count for embeddings? i'll put both in the card.

ravi: p50=38ms, p95=112ms (GPU v100 in us-east), cpu fallback p50=210ms. for embeddings we recommend shard_count=1 for >=8k vectors; use shard_count=2 for heavy fanout. note: quantized variants drop p95 by ~18ms but change tokenization compat a bit.

toni: also saw a broken anchor in the catalog page — the "compatibility-notes" anchor doesn't match the new heading generated by the mkdocs build. i'll open a follow-up to fix links.

ashley: can someone add a short migration note for users who relied on the old embed sharding auto-behavior? the change: explicit shard_count parameter required in SDK v2.

kevin: i'll lint the md and run the smoke build. quick FYI on the snippet: please use the new SDK pattern (client.model('tritonlite-2b').embed(...)) instead of the legacy .embeddings call. i pushed a tiny code sample in the PR.

samir: small snippet suggestion — show the shard param example and a fallback pattern. e.g.:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=REDWOOD_API_KEY)
# explicit shard_count to preserve deterministic shard mapping
embs = client.model("tritonlite-2b").embed(["doc1", "doc2"], shard_count=1)

# fallback: if embedding fails, retry without sharding
try:
    do_something(embs)
except Exception:
    embs = client.model("tritonlite-2b").embed(["doc1", "doc2"]) 
```

ashley: nice. i'll include that. Toni — want to own the link anchor fix? if you do, i'll add a note in the PR description to reviewers to check doc anchors and the mkdocs config.

toni: on it. i'll add an automated anchor check to the docs CI if possible (follow-up). for this PR i'll just patch the heading to match the anchor and add an inline comment.

ravi: one more callout for the model card: mention that the quantized variant changes tokenization of long unicode sequences (edge case). put a regression test note in the card so research can add a unit eval.

ashley: done — added a "regression test: long unicode sequence tokenization" checklist item in the PR. docs-bot: opened PR #4523 (https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4523) and added reviewers @toni @kevin @ravi.

docs-bot: PR created by ashley: "Add TritonLite-2B card + embed shard migration note" — CI pending.

kevin: CI failure on markdown lint — trailing whitespace in model-catalog/tritonlite-2b.md line 42. i'll push a fix. :hammer_and_wrench: 

ashley: thanks, kev. once lint is green can we fast-track this? it's blocking a support ticket for a customer migrating from legacy sharding.

ravi: approved the bench numbers. i'd prefer the card also link to the raw bench artifact and the sample script (both linked in the PR).

toni: anchor fix pushed, lint fixed. re-rerunning smoke.

kevin: smoke passed in us-east. merging after a quick editorial pass.

ashley: awesome — merging now. i'll follow up with the support team and paste the new snippet in the migration playbook. thanks all! :tada:
